import sys
ls=[l for l in sys.stdin.read().split('\n') if l]
if not ls: print('(empty)'); sys.exit()
ri=len(ls[0])-5; li=ls[0].rindex('│',0,ri)
print(f'li={li} n={len(ls)} trees={[l[:li].strip() for l in ls]}')
"; done
